definition.recovery_state: A state in which mandatory obligations are met without creating new shortfalls within the planning window.

recovery_horizon_days.definition: Number of days from start_date until all mandatory obligations are covered with no shortfall events.

rules.rule: A day is considered recovered only if ending_balance >= 0 AND no mandatory obligation is unpaid.
If any mandatory obligation is unpaid at its due_date, recovery is not achieved for the window.
Variable essentials may be underfunded without blocking recovery, but must be flagged.
One-time events do not block recovery unless they create a mandatory shortfall.

notes: This contract defines recovery mechanics only. It does not recommend actions or optimizations.
